system.description:
The old comic-book fancy of running up walls and across water is, for you, simple fact — at a full sprint ordinary obstacles cease to matter.

Spend a Blood Trait and a Willpower Trait to run across water, walls, ceilings or any relatively flat surface, needing only to keep moving to avoid falling (a Simple Test may be called on especially tricky surfaces). While it lasts you may always declare Fair Escape given room to run, smashing through closed windows or slipping past blocked doorways. Attempting any other action while running requires a Simple Test: win to act normally, tie to keep running without acting, or lose and crash into your destination, possibly taking damage.
system.bloodCost: One Blood Trait plus One Willpower Trait
